role_picker_desc: Select your role to start a personalized guided tour
admin_desc: Manage buildings, expenses, users, and financials
owner_desc: View your apartment balance, payment history, and notifications
step_1_desc: This is your dashboard. See total income, expenses, overdue units, and managed buildings at a glance.
step_2_desc: Everything starts here. Click "New Building" to enter the property address, floor count, and units.
step_3_desc: "Edit" to update building info. "Manage units" to see and edit each unit. "Assign owner" to link an owner account to a unit. "Hand over" to pass the building to another admin. "Deactivate" to pause it. "Delete" removes the building while keeping records.
step_4_desc: Add any shared cost here: water, electricity, maintenance, and more. Choose the category, amount, and split type. Each unit's share is automatically rounded up to the nearest 5.
step_5_desc: Search above the table to find an expense, click a column header to sort, and use the page controls at the bottom. Each row has actions: view details and each unit's share, edit, upload the bill, mark as paid, or delete (open balances are reversed).
step_6_desc: Create admin or owner accounts here. Admins have full access; owners see only their apartment data. "Deactivate" blocks login immediately without deleting records.
step_7_desc: The system includes 18 built-in categories in 5 groups. You can add custom categories to fit your building.
step_8_desc: Every action is automatically logged: who did it, what changed, and when. Search and sort the table for financial compliance and dispute resolution.
step_o1_desc: This is your personal dashboard. See your current balance, recent payments, and any new expenses added to your apartment.
step_o2_desc: The expenses that include your apartment. You see the total, your share after splitting, and payment status. Use the search box, column headers and page controls to find what you need. Adding and editing expenses is admin-only.
step_o3_desc: Every payment the admin records for your apartment appears here, each with a receipt number. Search or sort the table, and press "Receipt" to download the PDF for any payment.
step_o4_desc: Your full list of notifications: a reminder before payment is due, a confirmation when your payment is recorded, and a notice when a new expense is added. Mark them as read from here.
step_o5_desc: Change your name, phone number, or password here. Email and role are managed by the admin. You can also delete your account from this page.
step_8a_desc: Track physical equipment — elevators, generators, pumps, CCTV. Each asset carries a type, acquisition date, and value. When sold, record buyer details and sale price to maintain a complete asset ledger.
step_9_desc: Update your display name, phone number, profile picture, and preferred language here. Your language preference is saved and applied across all your devices. You can also delete your account from this page.
step_lang_desc: Tap here to switch between English and Arabic. The page flips to right-to-left and your choice is saved to your profile, so it follows you to every device.
step_bell_desc: The bell shows your unread count. Open it to switch between All and Unread, mark everything as read, or jump to the full notification center.
step_pay_desc: Every payment gets a numbered receipt: find it in the Receipt No column and download the PDF. Recorded a payment by mistake? Press "Reverse" and give a reason. The original stays on record and a reversal entry is added, so history is never erased.
step_rec_desc: Download a complete Excel export of the building's data for handover or your own backup. Meeting minutes and documents are kept on this page too.
step_plan_desc: See which plan your building is on and how many units it allows. Switch between Monthly and Yearly to compare prices: the yearly plan costs less. Upgrade by InstaPay and send the transfer reference.
step_more_desc: The side menu also has Operations, Maintenance reports, Votes, the Board, the monthly and annual Statement, and the monthly Subscription. This Help page has answers and support contacts.
step_o_more_desc: The side menu also has Maintenance reports, Votes, the monthly Statement and Minutes & documents. This Help page has answers and support contacts.
